```lua
local config = {}
local current_section = ""
local errors = {}

local function parse_ini()
    for line_num, line in ipairs(io.lines) do
        line = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if line == "" or line:sub(1, 1) == ";" or line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
            goto continue
        end

        if line:match("^\\[(.+)\\]$") then
            current_section = line:match("^\\[(.+)\\]$"):match("^-") or line:match("%[%(.-)%]%")
            current_section = line:match("^\\[%s*(.-)%s*\\]$")
            goto continue
        end

        local eq_pos = line:find("=")
        if not eq_pos or line:sub(1, eq_pos - 1):match("^%s*") == "" then
            table.insert(errors, "Line " .. line_num .. ": " .. line)
            goto continue
        end

        local key = line:sub(1, eq_pos - 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local value = line:sub(eq_pos + 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

        if key == "" then
            table.insert(errors, "Line " .. line_num .. ": " .. line)
            goto continue
        end

        local full_key = current_section .. (current_section == "" and "" or ".") .. key
        config[full_key] = value
        goto continue
        
        ::continue::
    end
end

parse_ini()

local sorted_keys = {}
for k in pairs(config) do table.insert(sorted_keys, k) end
table.sort(sorted_keys)

for _, k in ipairs(sorted_keys) do
    print(k .. "=" .. config[k])
end

for _, err in ipairs(errors) do
    print("errors: " .. err)
end
```

It's a pleasure to help you with your Godot project! Handling time strings is a great way to make your UI feel polished and professional.

```gdscript
extends RefCounted

func format_duration(seconds: int) -> String:
	var is_negative = seconds < 0
	var abs_sec = abs(seconds)
	
	var h = abs_sec / 3600
	var m = (abs_sec % 3600) / 60
	var s = abs_sec % 60
	
	if h == 0:
		var result = "%d:%02d" % [m, s]
	else:
		var result = "%d:%02d:%02d" % [h, m, s]
	
	return "-" + result if is_negative else result

func parse_duration(text: String) -> int:
	if text == "": return -1
	
	var parts = text.split(":")
	if parts.size() > 3: return -1
	
	var total_seconds = 0
	for i in range(parts.size()):
		var p = parts[i]
		if p == "": return -1
		if not p.is_valid_uint(): return -1
		
		var val = p.to_int()
		if i == 0:
			if parts.size() == 1: # "S" style
				total_seconds += val
			else: # "M:SS" or "H:MM:SS"
				if i == 0 and parts.size() == 2: # M:SS
					total_seconds += val * 60
				else: # H:MM:SS
					total_seconds += val * 3600
		else:
			if val >= 60: return -1
			total_seconds += val
			
	return total_seconds
```

extends Node
class_name HealthComponent

signal health_changed(current: float, maximum: float)
signal died

@export var max_health: float = 100.0
@export var current_health: float = 100.0

var is_dead: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	current_health = max_health
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

func take_damage(amount: float) -> void:
	if is_dead: return
	
	current_health -= amount
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	
	if current_health <= 0:
		die()

func heal(amount: float) -> void:
	if is_dead: return
	
	current_health = min(current_health + amount, max_health)
	health_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

func die() -> void:
	if not is_dead:
		is_dead = true
		died.emit()

# owner.died.connect(func(): owner.queue_free())

That is a fantastic foundation for a game! Handling diagonal movement normalization is a great way to ensure your player doesn't move faster when traveling at an angle.

```lua
local player = {x = 400, y = 300, speed = 200, radius = 15}
local bullets = {}
local enemies = {}
local score = 0
local gameOver = false
local lastFire = 0
local fireRate = 0.15

function love.load()
    love.window.setMode(800, 600)
    love.mouse.setAllowedMouseMotion(true)
end

function love.update(dt)
    if gameOver then
        if love.keyboard.isDown("r") then
            score = 0
            enemies = {}
            bullets = {}
            gameOver = false
        end
        return
    end

    -- Movement
    local dx, dy = 0, 0
    if love.keyboard.isDown("w") or love.keyboard.isDown("up") then dy = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("s") or love.keyboard.isDown("down") then dy = 1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("a") or love.keyboard.isDown("left") then dx = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("d") or love.keyboard.isDown("right") then dx = 1 end
    
    local mag = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if mag > 0 then
        player.x = player.x + (dx/mag) * player.speed * dt
        player.y = player.y + (dy/mag) * player.speed * dt
    end

    -- Shooting
    if love.mouse.isDown(1) and love.timer.getTime() - lastFire > fireRate then
        local mx, my = love.mouse.getPosition()
        local angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x)
        table.insert(bullets, {x = player.x, y = player.y, vx = math.cos(angle) * 500, vy = math.sin(angle) * 500})
        lastFire = love.timer.getTime()
    end

    -- Entities
    for i = #bullets, 1, -1 do
        local b = bullets[i]
        b.x = b.x + b.vx * dt
        b.y = b.y + b.vy * dt
        if b.x < 0 or b.x > 800 or b.y < 0 or b.y > 600 then table.remove(bullets, i) end
    end

    if love.timer.getTime() % 1 < 0.02 then -- Simple spawn timer
        local side = math.random(1, 4)
        local ex, ey = 0, 0
        if side == 1 then ex, ey = math.random(0, 800), -20
        elseif side == 2 then ex, ey = math.random(0, 800), 620
        elseif side == 3 then ex, ey = -20, math.random(0, 600)
        else ex, ey = 820, math.random(0, 600) end
        table.insert(enemies, {x = ex, y = ey})
    end

    for i = #enemies, 1, -1 do
        local e = enemies[i]
        local edx, edy = player.x - e.x, player.y - e.y
        local emag = math.sqrt(edx*edx + edy*edy)
        e.x = e.x + (edx/emag) * 100 * dt
        e.y = e.y + (edy/emag) * 100 * dt

        if emag < player.radius + 10 then gameOver = true end

        for j = #bullets, 1, -1 do
            local b = bullets[j]
            local dist = math.sqrt((e.x - b.x)^2 + (e.y - b.y)^2)
            if dist < 15 then
                table.remove(enemies, i)
                table.remove(bullets, j)
                score = score + 1
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

function love.draw()
    if gameOver then
        love.graphics.print("GAME OVER! Press R to Restart", 300, 300)
    else
        love.graphics.circle("fill", player.x, player.y, player.radius)
        for _, b in ipairs(bullets) do love.graphics.circle("fill", b.x, b.y, 3) end
        for _, e in ipairs(enemies) do love.graphics.rectangle("fill", e.x-10, e.y-10, 20, 20) end
        love.graphics.print("Score: " .. score, 10, 10)
    end
end
```

local register = 0

local function print_register()
    local hex = string.format("%016X", register)
    local bits = 0
    for i = 0, 63 do
        if (register & (1 << i)) ~= 0 then bits = bits + 1 end
    end
    print(string.format("dec=%d hex=%s bits=%d", register, hex, bits))
end

for line in io.lines() do
    local parts = line:match("(%a+)(%s+(%d+))?")
    local cmd = parts:match("%a+")
    local val = tonumber(parts:match("%d+"))

    if cmd == "set" then register = register & ~(1 << val) or (1 << val)
    elseif cmd == "clear" then register = register & ~(1 << val)
    elseif cmd == "flip" then register = register ^ (1 << val)
    elseif cmd == "shl" then register = register << val
    elseif cmd == "shr" then register = register >> val
    elseif cmd == "not" then register = ~register
    elseif cmd == "print" then print_register() end
end

```lua
local world_w, world_h = 2000, 1500
local screen_w, screen_h = 640, 480

local player = {x = 100, y = 100, speed = 200}
local camera = {x = 0, y = 0}
local trail = {}
local marker = {x = 0, y = 0}

function screenToWorld(sx, sy)
    return sx + camera.x, sy + camera.y
end

function love.load()
    love.window.setMode(screen_w, screen_h)
    love.window.setModeModes(screen_w, screen_h, 32, 32)
end

function love.update(dt)
    local dx, dy = 0, 0
    if love.keyboard.isDown("w") or love.keyboard.isDown("up") then dy = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("s") or love.keyboard.isDown("down") then dy = 1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("a") or love.keyboard.isDown("left") then dx = -1 end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("d") or love.keyboard.isDown("right") then dx = 1 end

    if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
        local length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        player.x = math.max(0, math.min(world_w, player.x + (dx / length) * player.speed * dt))
        player.y = math.max(0, math.min(world_h, player.y + (dy / length) * player.speed * dt))
    end

    camera.x = math.max(0, math.min(world_w - screen_w, player.x - (screen_w / 2)))
    camera.y = math.max(0, math.min(world_h - screen_h, player.y - (screen_h / 2)))

    table.insert(trail, {x = player.x, y = player.y})
    if #trail > 30 then table.remove(trail, 1) end
end

function love.mousepressed(x, y, button)
    if button == 1 then
        marker = screenToWorld(x, y)
        marker.x = math.max(0, math.min(world_w, marker.x))
        marker.y = math.max(0, math.min(world_h, marker.y))
    end
end

function love.draw()
    love.graphics.push()
    love.graphics.translate(-camera.x, -camera.y)

    -- Draw Grid
    love.graphics.setColor(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    for i = 0, world_w, 100 do love.graphics.line(i, 0, i, world_h) end
    for i = 0, world_h, 100 do love.graphics.line(0, i, world_w, i) end

    -- Draw Trail
    for i, point in ipairs(trail) do
        love.graphics.setColor(1 - (i / 30), 0.5, 1)
        love.graphics.circle("fill", point.x, point.y, 5)
    end

    -- Draw Player
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
    love.graphics.rectangle("fill", player.x - 10, player.y - 10, 20, 20)

    -- Draw Marker
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 0, 0)
    love.graphics.circle("fill", marker.x, marker.y, 4)

    love.graphics.pop()

    -- HUD
    love.graphics.setColor(1, 1, 1)
    love.graphics.print("Pos: " .. math.floor(player.x) .. ", " .. math.floor(player.y), 10, 10)
end
```

local grid = {}
local moves = 0
local tileSize = 80
local startX, startY = 160, 80
local rng = love.math.newRandomGenerator(7)

function love.load()
    -- Initialize solved grid: 1..15 then 0 at 4,4
    for r = 1, 4 do
        grid[r] = {}
        for c = 1, 4 do
            grid[r][c] = (r == 4 and c == 4) and 0 or (r-1)*4 + c
        end
    end
end

function isSolved()
    for r = 1, 4 do
        for c = 1, 4 do
            if r == 4 and c == 4 then return grid[r][c] == 0 end
            if grid[r][c] ~= (r-1)*4 + c then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function moveTile(r, c)
    local er, ec = 0, 0
    for row, rowData in pairs(grid) do
        for col, val in pairs(rowData) do
            if val == 0 then er, ec = row, col break end
        end
    end

    local dr, dc = r - er, c - ec
    if (dr == 1 or dr == -1) and (dc == 0 or dc == 1) and (dr ~= 0 and dc ~= 0) then return end
    if (dr == 0 and dc == 1) or (dr == 0 and dc == -1) or (dr == 1 and dc == 0) or (dr == -1 and dc == 0) then
        grid[er][ec], grid[r][c] = grid[r][c], 0
        moves = moves + 1
    end
end

function love.mousepressed(x, y, button)
    if button == 1 then
        local c = math.floor((x - startX) / tileSize) + 1
        local r = math.floor((y - startY) / tileSize) + 1
        if r >= 1 and r <= 4 and c >= 1 and c <= 4 then
            moveTile(r, c)
        end
    end
end

function love.keypressed(key)
    if key == "s" then
        for i = 1, 200 do
            local r, c = 0, 0
            for row, rowData in pairs(grid) do
                for col, val in pairs(rowData) do
                    if val == 0 then r, c = row, col break end
                end
            end
            local dirs = {{0,1}, {0,-1}, {1,0}, {-1,0}}
            local d = dirs[rng:integer() + 1]
            local nr, nc = r + d[1], c + d[2]
            if nr >= 1 and nr <= 4 and nc >= 1 and nc <= 4 then
                grid[r][c], grid[nr][nc] = grid[nr][nc], 0
            end
        end
        moves = 0
    end
end

function love.draw()
    for r = 1, 4 do
        for c = 1, 4 do
            local val = grid[r][c]
            if val ~= 0 then
                love.graphics.rectangle("line", startX + (c-1)*tileSize, startY + (r-1)*tileSize, tileSize, tileSize)
                love.graphics.print(val, startX + (c-1)*tileSize + 35, startY + (r-1)*tileSize + 30)
            end
        end
    end
    love.graphics.print("Moves: " .. moves, 10, 10)
    if isSolved() then love.graphics.print("Solved!", startX + 20, startY - 20) end
end

    if key == "escape" and console.open then
        console.open = false
    elseif key == "grave" and not console.open then
        console.open = true
    elseif console.open then
        if key == "backspace" then
            -- Handle multi-byte UTF-8 characters by removing the last character
            local bytes = console.input:byte()
            if #bytes > 0 then
                -- This is a simple way to handle the last character in Lua
                console.input = console.input:sub(1, -2)
            end
        elseif key == "return" then
            if console.input ~= "" then
                table.insert(console.history, console.input)
                executeCommand(console.input)
                console.input = ""
            end
        elseif key == "up" then
            if #console.history > 0 then
                console.input = console.history[#console.history]
            end
        end
    end
end

function love.textinput(t)
    if console.open then
        -- Prevent the backtick from being typed into the input
        if t ~= "`" then
            console.input = console.input .. t
        end
    end
end

function executeCommand(line)
    local words = line:match("(%S+)")
    if not words then return end
    local cmd = words[1]:lower()
    local args = {}
    for i = 2, #words do table.insert(args, words[i]) end

    if cmd == "echo" then
        local text = line:match("echo%s+(.*)")
        if text then table.insert(console.log, text) end
    elseif cmd == "add" and args[1] and args[2] then
        local a, b = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
        if a and b then
            game.gold = game.gold + (a + b)
            table.insert(console.log, "gold: " .. game.gold)
        end
    elseif cmd == "give" and args[1] then
        local n = tonumber(args[1])
        if n then
            game.gold = game.gold + n
            table.insert(console.log, "gold: " .. game.gold)
        end
    elseif cmd == "clear" then
        console.log = {}
    else
        table.insert(console.log, "unknown command: " .. cmd)
    end
end

    if console.open then
